transcript.message: Dana, this is Arta from Outsorcy. I'm calling cold. I saw Corvid has two SDR roles posted at seventy-five to eighty-five OTE. For what one of those costs you loaded I can put two full-time SDRs on your team from our office. Can I take forty seconds to say how, and you decide?
The postings are live on LinkedIn, about three weeks old. Are they real, or left over?
Approved for after the round. We're frozen until it closes. Call me in two months.

Then the timing is the reason to talk now, not later. From a brief to someone on the floor is four to five weeks for us, and nothing is committed until you choose a person. Start the search now and the two seats are producing the week the round closes instead of five months after. What did your last SDR cost you fully loaded?
About a hundred and ten. Gone in seven months.

So a hundred and ten for maybe two productive months after ramp. Our seat is about thirty-five hundred a month, so roughly forty-two a year, plus a one-time onboarding fee, and commission sits on top. The person is a full-time employee in our office in Pristina with a manager on the floor; you interview them and pick.
Thirty-five hundred is forty-two a year. Plus what, exactly, on the onboarding fee?
It's a one-time fee per hire; I'd rather Travis, our AE, give you the exact figure against your contract than have me round it. Fair?
Mm. Kosovo. Where is that, exactly, and why would I put pipeline in the hands of people there?

Balkans, next to Albania and North Macedonia. Our office is in Pristina, the capital. The people are our full-time employees, we're the US employer of record, they work your hours, nine to five Eastern, and a manager on our floor reviews calls daily. A healthtech client of ours booked about two hundred and fifty qualified meetings in a quarter against a plan of a hundred with a team built this way. Travis can walk you through that account.
Yes, and he'll put you in touch. Twenty minutes with Travis, Thursday at eleven or Friday at nine Eastern. Which?
Thursday at eleven. Twenty minutes. Send the invite to d whitfield at corvidhealth dot com.
Thursday at eleven Eastern, twenty minutes with Travis, invite to d whitfield at corvidhealth dot com. Thank you, Dana.
